items.question: Which business setup and licensing services do free zones in the UAE provide?
items.gold: Company registration and incorporation, trade name registration, and issuing licences across diverse sectors.
items.fact: Free zones provide company registration, trade names, and licences

items.question: Do UAE free zones offer duty-free import and export for goods that do not enter the UAE local market?
items.gold: Yes, duty-free import/export is offered for goods not entering the UAE local market.
items.fact: Free zones offer duty-free trade for goods not entering local market
